expeditions.name: 40th Indian Scientific Expedition to Antarctica
expeditions.title: 40th Indian Scientific Expedition to Antarctica
expeditions.sourceExcerpt: The 40th expedition journey will be flagged off from Goa on January 5, 2021, with 43 members onboard. The chartered ice-class vessel MV Vasiliy Golovnin will make this journey and will reach Antarctica in 30 days.
expeditions.creditLine: Source: Press Information Bureau, Government of India
expeditions.nodalAgency: National Centre for Polar and Ocean Research (NCPOR), Ministry of Earth Sciences
expeditions.focus: Climate change, crustal evolution, and polar environmental observation

expeditions.name: 41st Indian Scientific Expedition to Antarctica
expeditions.title: 41st Indian Scientific Expedition to Antarctica
expeditions.sourceExcerpt: The 41st Indian Scientific Expedition to Antarctica launched from National Centre for Polar and Ocean Research (NCPOR), Goa on November 15, 2021.
expeditions.creditLine: Source: Press Information Bureau, Government of India
expeditions.nodalAgency: National Centre for Polar and Ocean Research (NCPOR)

expeditions.name: 42nd Indian Scientific Expedition to Antarctica
expeditions.title: 42nd Indian Scientific Expedition to Antarctica
expeditions.sourceExcerpt: The 42nd Indian Scientific Expedition to Antarctica deployed ice-tethered oceanographic mooring at Prydz Bay, East Antarctica, to collect data on the physical parameters of the under-ice water column.
expeditions.creditLine: Source: Press Information Bureau, Government of India
expeditions.nodalAgency: National Centre for Polar and Ocean Research (NCPOR), Ministry of Earth Sciences
expeditions.focus: Deployed ice-tethered oceanographic mooring at Prydz Bay, East Antarctica, to collect data on the physical parameters of the under-ice water column

expeditions.name: 43rd Indian Scientific Expedition to Antarctica
expeditions.title: 43rd Indian Scientific Expedition to Antarctica
expeditions.sourceExcerpt: The 43rd Indian Scientific Expedition to Antarctica was launched with the first batch of 19 members travelling to Antarctica in October 2023.
expeditions.creditLine: Source: Press Information Bureau, Government of India
expeditions.nodalAgency: National Centre for Polar and Ocean Research (NCPOR), Ministry of Earth Sciences
expeditions.focus: Launched with the first batch of 19 members travelling to Antarctica in October 2023

expeditions.name: First Indian Winter Scientific Arctic Expedition
expeditions.title: First Indian Winter Scientific Arctic Expedition
expeditions.sourceExcerpt: The Honourable Union Minister, Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES), Sh Kiren Rijiju, flagged off India's first winter scientific expedition to the Arctic from the MoES headquarters in New Delhi on December 18, 2023.
expeditions.creditLine: Source: Press Information Bureau, Government of India
expeditions.nodalAgency: National Centre for Polar and Ocean Research (NCPOR), Ministry of Earth Sciences
expeditions.focus: Atmospheric observations, space weather, sea-ice dynamics, and biological adaptations during polar night
